detail: Wave three: T-156 settings menu and Profil toko, T-157 multiple pickup points (migrations 0045 and 0046), T-158 Outlet/Koneksi split, T-162 state summary panels, T-163 one date-range filter. Independent review returned FAIL with one blocker: COD from a non-default pickup point could never be issued, because the COD totals read and three RLS INSERT policies still required the estimate origin to equal the outlet default. Fixed in both layers and bound by a named test. Four further findings taken: removal of an in-use pickup point refused, the migration verifier's incomplete-pair guard de-vacuumed, the queue panel names a status it does not carry, and the shipment detail replays the range. Integration also found and fixed a permanently mounted role=dialog that collided with the command palette. tsc and ESLint clean, 104 files / 1028 tests, migration upgrade verifier through 0046, seven browser audits pass, developer database at 47 migrations with data unchanged.
